name: backdoors-benchmark-dataset
description: A dataset for evaluating language-model susceptibility and defenses against backdoor triggers and poisoned contexts. It provides examples of poisoned inputs, target (backdoored) behaviors, and benign controls to measure whether models emit malicious/backdoored outputs when presented with specific triggers. Designed to support research on detection, mitigation, and robustness of models to backdoor attacks.
evaluation_method: attack_success_rate (ASR) primarily, often reported alongside false-positive rate and standard classification metrics (precision/recall/F1)
reputation: A niche benchmark used by research groups studying adversarial/backdoor threats to LMs and defenses, with limited mainstream adoption outside security research.
